content: No one is high and no one is low by birth alone; he who realizes the Supreme Truth is truly noble.
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir revolted against hereditary caste hierarchies and religious elitism. True nobility is an achievement of conscious character, spiritual purity, and living truth.
practicalInsight: Evaluate every individual today purely on their integrity and character, completely ignoring their pedigree, wealth, or labels.
reflectionPrompt: In what subtle ways do I still categorize people based on superficial social pedigree?
